data.gender_notes: रवि is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: रविः (Raviḥ) is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘रवि’ (Ravi), meaning ‘Sun’. In Hindu mythology, Ravi is the deity of the sun, representing light, energy, and warmth. He is also revered as a symbol of power, wisdom, and strength. The name रवि carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose रवि usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ravi represents the powerful influence of the sun in Hindu culture. It signifies the energy, warmth, and light that the sun provides which are essential to life. Sun worship was an essential part of various Hindu traditions and the sun deity, Ravi, was one of the most revered gods. Temples, festivals, and rituals were dedicated to him, emphasizing his importance in Hindu society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ravi is a symbol of enlightenment, illumination, and consciousness. The sun represents the inner radiance that shines from within individuals and helps them understand the deeper truths of life. The name Ravi reminds people to seek knowledge, wisdom, and self-realization, driving them towards spiritual growth. Furthermore, the Sun is believed to be a gateway for the inner journey and serves as a reminder to explore one's inner self while pursuing a balanced, healthy, and satisfying life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ravi, meaning 'sun' in Sanskrit, symbolizes the radiant and enlightening force of the Sun God. It represents the power to illuminate and bring warmth to life, embodying the qualities of energy, vitality, and illumination.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ravi is a name of the Sun God in Hindu mythology. The name रवि carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ravi is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the root word 'ravi' which means 'shining', 'bright' or 'sun'. It is also a name of the Sun God in Hindu mythology.
